aaaaaaaaconroot00000000000000000.title: Indonesian consumer staples deliver double-digit EPS growth into 2026
aaaaaaaaconroot00000000000000000.body: Top-down: middle-class real-wage recovery + election-cycle fiscal stimulus + easing rates lift staples volumes 5-7% YoY while pricing power offsets input-cost pressure, supporting double-digit EPS growth across top-3 names.

aaaaaaaaconmacsub000000000000000.title: Indonesian middle-class real wages turn positive YoY by Q2 2026
aaaaaaaaconmacsub000000000000000.body: Wage growth: nominal wage growth re-accelerates to 7-9% YoY while CPI converges to 3% target band, restoring positive real wage growth for the first time since 2023. Drives staples volume re-acceleration in H2 2026.

aaaaaaaaconmacassump000000000000.title: No major IDR depreciation event (>10% vs USD) through 2026
aaaaaaaaconmacassump000000000000.body: Base case: IDR remains range-bound. A sharp depreciation would force input-cost passthrough that breaks the volume + margin combination central to the thesis.
aaaaaaaaconmacassump000000000000.if_violated: Margin compression > 200bp; volume thesis still holds but EPS growth halves.

aaaaaaaaconindsub000000000000000.title: Staples sector volume growth accelerates from 3% to 6% YoY by Q4 2026
aaaaaaaaconindsub000000000000000.body: Industry: weighted top-3 staples volume re-accelerates as real-wage tailwind feeds through the consumer purchase frequency channel. Pricing growth steady at ~4% on input-cost passthrough.

aaaaaaaaconindhyp000000000000000.title: Distribution-channel mix shift toward modern trade adds 50-80bp to gross margin
aaaaaaaaconindhyp000000000000000.body: Hypothesis: the ongoing modern-trade share gain compresses trade-promotion intensity vs. general trade, lifting gross margin 50-80bp at the sector level. Falsifiable via company-by-company channel-mix disclosures.
aaaaaaaaconindhyp000000000000000.falsification_criteria: Modern-trade share gain >150bp YoY without observed margin expansion in any major name during 2026.
